attorneys: Stephen C. Vladeck and Judith P. Vladeck for appellants., Theodore R. Iserman and Frederick T. Shea for appellee., Louis J. Lefkowits, Attorney General of New York, pro se, Samuel A. opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a properly presented federal question.
